messages:
Sam (Sales): Quick kickoff note — FinBank POC wants EU-only data residency for inference. They asked for: EU sub-processor list, geo-pin routing (tenant-level), BYOK/KMS in-region, pricing delta for geo-pin and egress, and a test tenant + allowlist. Can infra/ops confirm feasibility and rough pricing?

Alex B: We can do tenant-pinning to eu-west-1 with sticky routing (session affinity). Initial pricing estimate: ~+15% on hosted token unit costs for reserved geo-pin + potential egress add-on. Need to validate with infra for exact numbers. Also need to check which edge CDNs count as subprocessors.

Maria L: Current subprocessors for EU workloads: GCP (eu-west1), AWS (eu-west-1), FastEdgeCDN (EU PoPs), and our observability provider (eu-only partition). FastEdgeCDN is contracted EU-only for this account class. I'll drop the attestation link in a follow-up.

Jordan (Solutions): Customer insists on BYOK (customer-managed keys) with keys physically pinned to EU KMS. Can we support per-tenant KMS keys in eu-west-1 for Hosted? Also they require notification + explicit opt-in before any cross-border fallback to non-EU.

Amy (Legal): Flag: we'll need the full subprocessor list + signed attestation before DPA amendment. Also need an audit trail for KMS operations (key usage logs) and confirmation of region-bound HSM/KMS. Timeline matters for legal signoff.

Alex B: BYOK -> we support customer-managed keys for Dedicated and Private. For Hosted, we support BYOK in some regions via cloud KMS integration (depends on cloud provider). I will check if eu-west-1 BYOK path is enabled for this tenant class. Fallback policy can be configured: {"routing_policy":"geo_preference","pinning":"tenant","fallback":"notify_and_opt_in"} 

deploy-bot: Docs updated: https://redwood.internal/docs/presales/geo-routing - created ticket INF-4321 for infra pricing confirmation and OPS-allowlist for EU test tenant.

Sam (Sales): Thanks. Two asks to prioritize: 1) Concrete delta for token pricing + egress for eu-only pin, 2) Estimated lead time to spin up a shadow test tenant in eu-west-1 we can give the customer. Can we get both by EOD Wed?

Maria L: I'll run egress/infra cost sims — egress depends on whether customer uses embeddings heavily (vector store egress). Quick back-of-envelope: 0.02 USD per 1k tokens extra on top of base if heavy embedding egress; will confirm. For the test tenant, we can provision a temp tenant with isolate networking — need customer's CIDR block(s) for IP allowlist and preferred peering method (Public IP or PrivateLink).

Jordan (Solutions): I'll ask the customer for CIDR and whether they want mutual TLS peering. Also they asked for certs list for peering. Do we support mTLS for hosted PrivateLink?

Alex B: mTLS available for PrivateLink + Private deployments. For pure hosted public API, we only offer standard TLS and API keys. For BYOK in-hosted, we may require a CSP-specific KMS integration (we need to confirm with infra ticket).

Amy (Legal): Also confirm: customer forbids subprocessors in Russia/China. Maria — can you confirm FastEdgeCDN has no PoPs in those countries? If any subproc has presence there we need to escalate.

Maria L: Confirmed: FastEdgeCDN contract for this partner class is EU-only PoPs. No presence in RU/CN for contracted instances. I'll include the subproc attestation doc link in INF-4321.

Sam (Sales): Great. I'll consolidate answers into the presales deck and update pricing appendix. After infra confirms numbers, we'll propose a 4-week POC: week1 on-boarding + allowlist, week2 validation, week3 scale tests, week4 handoff.

Jordan (Solutions): One more operational note: if fallback becomes necessary, the customer wants an automated rollback policy plus an audit email to their security contact and ours. Can implement via webhook on routing-fallback events.

Alex B: Good. We can emit events to a webhook and include reason codes (capacity, region outage, manual override). Sample event: ```{ "event":"routing_fallback","tenant":"finbank-poc","from":"eu-west-1","to":"us-east-1","reason":"eu_capacity_exhausted" }```

Amy (Legal): That event data should be included in the DPA amendment. Also need retention window for logs (customer asked for 7 years for audit). That's a heavy ask — flagging for privacy team.

Sam (Sales): :thumbsup: Moving to infra/ops handoff. Will update the deal thread once INF-4321 and the attestation doc are in. Thanks everyone.

Maria L: Will update INF-4321 by EOD tomorrow with cost sims and subproc attestation.

deploy-bot: Ticket INF-4321 assigned to infra-team, priority MED.

Sam (Sales): @Amy I'll loop legal in the customer call tomorrow at 10am CET.

Amy (Legal): On it. :rotating_light: Please share the attestation doc and any BYOK design notes before the call.
